scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org metorial --project mte-cargo ./dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org metorial --project mte-cargo ./dist
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps:if-token: sh -c 'if [ -n "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then bun run sentry:sourcemaps; else echo "Skipping Sentry sourcemap upload"; fi'
scripts.dev:docker: docker compose -p cargo -f ./docker-compose.dev.yml --profile infra --profile service up -d --pull always --build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -p cargo -f ./docker-compose.dev.yml --profile infra up -d --pull always
scripts.db:push:dev: sh -c 'set -a; . .env; set +a; bun prisma db push --accept-data-loss'
scripts.db:push:test: sh -c 'set -a; . .env.test; set +a; bun prisma db push --accept-data-loss'
scripts.db:push: bun run db:push:dev && bun run db:push:test
